title: Nostalgic Flaky Vietnamese Flour Bao
description: A nostalgic Vietnamese snack that combines a flaky dough with sweet plum jam and tempered chocolate for a delightful bite.
instructions: In a bowl whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt together.
Dissolve yeast in warm water and let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Add yeast mixture and melted butter to dry mixture and stir until smooth dough forms.
Turn dough onto floured surface and knead for 5 minutes until elastic.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in warm spot until doubled, about 45 minutes.
Punch down dough, divide into 8 equal portions, and roll each into a 5cm circle.
Melt chocolate and cocoa butter together over low heat until glossy, then let cool to 30°C.
Spread 3.75g of plum jam on each dough circle and top with 8g of tempered chocolate.
Fold halves over to form sealed bao and place on parchment lined tray.
Bake at 180°C for 12 minutes until lightly golden.
